description.value: Passions are about to flare for the Concannon sisters ... Maggie and Brianna Concannon are very different. The calm and gentle Brie seems able to weather any storm, even the constant criticism that rains down on them both from their mother, but Maggie is a passionate and fiery artist whose temper is as bold as her art. Their mother's bitterness is a mystery to the sisters. It's Maggie's skill as a glass blower that brings international gallery owner Rogan Sweeney to her small cottage in County Clare. His interest is purely professional until their personalities clash and sparks begin to fly ... how will Maggie cope with feelings for Rogan she would rather ignore?
